caption: The drawing shows two views of a single round plate. At the top, the plate is depicted from above, revealing the entire surface. The rim is brown with black script written along the circumference. Inside, the plate has a beige or light yellow background and displays a decorative floral pattern with red, green, yellow, and brown colors. There are three main stylized flowers with greenish stems and leaves; two of the flowers are large and prominently colored in red and yellow with darker outlines, and one is smaller and positioned near the rim. Several green leaves and a central motif with a diamond pattern in red and yellow occupy the middle of the plate. Beneath this top view, there is a side profile of the plate showing its shallow depth and curved shape. This side view is shaded in gradient browns, highlighting the curved rim and the incline towards the center. The drawing is on an off-white or beige background with slight discoloration from age.
title: Pa. German Plate
